hotel.name: Hotel Savoy, a Rocco Forte Hotel

verified_facts.text: Hotel Savoy is at Piazza della Repubblica 7 in Florence.
verified_facts.excerpt: Piazza della Repubblica 7

verified_facts.text: The Savoy first opened its doors to guests in 1893.
verified_facts.excerpt: The old Savoy hotel, one of Florence’s grandest, first opened its doors to guests in 1893.

verified_facts.text: Sir Rocco Forte acquired the property in 1998 and carried out a top-to-toe renovation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sir Rocco Forte acquired the property in 1998 and carried out a top-to-toe renovation.

verified_facts.text: The interiors were re-imagined by Olga Polizzi, Director of Design for Rocco Forte Hotels and Sir Rocco's sister.
verified_facts.excerpt: The interiors have been re-imagined by Olga Polizzi, Director of Design for Rocco Forte Hotels - and Sir Rocco’s sister -

verified_facts.text: Irene is the hotel's trattoria, named in honour of Lady Forte.
verified_facts.excerpt: Welcome to Irene – a love letter to Tuscany named in honour of Lady Forte.

verified_facts.text: Chef Fulvio Pierangelini's menu at Irene is a delicate take on authentic Tuscan food.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chef Fulvio Pierangelini’s menu is a delicate take on authentic Tuscan food.

verified_facts.text: Irene's terrace on Piazza della Repubblica offers front-row views of city life.
verified_facts.excerpt: The terrace on Piazza della Repubblica offers front-row views of city life.

verified_facts.text: Irene features Loro Piana fabrics, hand-blown Venetian chandeliers and Pietrasanta marble.
verified_facts.excerpt: Loro Piana fabrics, hand-blown Venetian chandeliers and Pietrasanta marble are reminiscent of a Florentine home.

verified_facts.text: The Irene restaurant and Artemisia Cocktail Bar re-opened in spring 2025 after a major re-fit.
verified_facts.excerpt: The ground-floor Irene restaurant and cosy new Artemisia Cocktail Bar re-opened in spring 2025 after a major re-fit.

verified_facts.text: Artemisia Gentileschi, the bar's namesake, pioneered artistic expression in 17th-century Florence.
verified_facts.excerpt: A rule-breaker and trailblazer, Artemisia Gentileschi pioneered female empowerment and artistic expression in 17th century Florence.

verified_facts.text: At Bar Artemisia, Maestro Salvatore Calabrese and his team reinvent aperitivo cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Behind the bar, Maestro Salvatore Calabrese and his team reinvent the aperitivo cocktails

verified_facts.text: Bar Artemisia's menu features female-produced spirits, Super Tuscan wines and twists on the classics.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vibrant female-produced spirits, super Tuscan wines, and twists on the classics

verified_facts.text: The Artist Suites host artworks by contemporary artists that are available for purchase.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Savoy has decided to host artworks, available for purchase, of world-famous contemporary artists in its Artist Suites.

verified_facts.text: The Duomo Presidential Suite occupies its own wing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our opulent Duomo Presidential Suite is the pinnacle of luxury at Hotel Savoy, occupying its own wing

verified_facts.text: The Repubblica Suite has three private balconies with views over the Column of Abundance.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Repubblica Suite enjoys three private balconies, generous living and dining spaces, and views over the historic Column of Abundance.

verified_facts.text: The rooms showcase fine Tuscan silks and local artwork.
verified_facts.excerpt: Showcasing fine Tuscan silks and local artwork, our rooms channel the city's culture of splendour

verified_facts.text: Marble bathrooms are stocked with Irene Forte organic bath products made by Sir Rocco's daughter.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marble bathrooms are stocked with the in-house Irene Forte organic bath products produced by Sir Rocco’s daughter.

verified_facts.text: There are plenty of connecting rooms for families.
verified_facts.excerpt: there are also plenty of connecting rooms for families

verified_facts.text: The hotel's My Happy Florence tour for kids visits Palazzo Davanzati and Museo Galileo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Start with a visit to Palazzo Davanzati, then head to Museo Galileo

verified_facts.text: The subterranean gym has Technogym equipment and a dedicated fitness studio.
verified_facts.excerpt: The subterranean gym is well-sized for an 80-room hotel, and comes stocked with Technogym equipment and a dedicated fitness studio.

verified_facts.text: In a mixology class, guests learn to make the Negroni and discover its origins in Florence.
verified_facts.excerpt: you will learn how to make the perfect Negroni and discover its origins here in Florence.

verified_facts.text: Guests can create their own fragrance in a perfume experience with AquaFlor Firenze.
verified_facts.excerpt: Create your own fragrance, discover exclusive essences and learn the secrets and techniques of artistic perfumery in this sensory journey with AquaFlor Firenze.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a bespoke, individually tailored Ferrari road trip.
verified_facts.excerpt: a bespoke, individually tailored Ferrari road trip.

verified_facts.text: Families can do an art treasure hunt through the Uffizi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Families enjoy the art treasure hunt through the Uffizi for a new perspective on the museum.

verified_facts.text: Most rooms have views of the Duomo or Piazza della Repubblica.
verified_facts.excerpt: most rooms have views of the Duomo or busy Piazza della Repubblica.

verified_facts.text: There is no dress code, but guests are asked to avoid sportswear, shorts and beach shoes in the restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: refrain from wearing sportswear, shorts and beach shoes in our restaurants.
